title: Identify records and index lookups using nested values
goal: Use non-collection complex scalar paths for identity and lookup indexes, and provider-specific JSON path indexes; on EF11 RC2 use explicit LINQ identity lookup because nested-key FindAsync fails.

selectionNotes: EF Core 11 relational; verify provider support for the actual JSON path. TPT base scalar/JSON, TPC base scalar and TPC concrete-subtype JSON are the executed routes.
Provider-specific keys use required non-collection complex scalar paths. Keys exclude complex collections, nullable complex paths and JSON document properties.

RC2: inherited-base JSON under TPC fails materialization; nested-key FindAsync fails translation. Use concrete-subtype JSON and explicit LINQ identity predicates as shown. No later-build fix is claimed.

constraints: EF Core 11 relational; verify provider support for the actual JSON path. TPT base scalar/JSON, TPC base scalar and TPC concrete-subtype JSON are the executed routes.
Provider-specific keys use required non-collection complex scalar paths. Keys exclude complex collections, nullable complex paths and JSON document properties.

RC2: inherited-base JSON under TPC fails materialization; nested-key FindAsync fails translation. Use concrete-subtype JSON and explicit LINQ identity predicates as shown. No later-build fix is claimed.
SQL Server JSON path indexes require native json and a clustered primary key. No collection/wildcard index, optimizer plan, speed improvement, production migration or GA verification is claimed.
Previous .NET10/EF10 comparison uses value-converted inherited locations, flat keys/lookup columns and a computed JSON lookup index. It is historical evidence, not another .NET10 foundation.
prerequisites: Copy every file of one complete project to its own directory, install its pinned SDK/runtime and restore locked packages online. Offline guidance retrieval is separate from consumer dependency setup.
Supply PLAYBOOK_SQL_CONNECTION_STRING privately for an empty exclusively owned disposable playbook_ database. The sample creates schema with EnsureCreated; never use an existing application database.

The Test-FenStore helper uses the already authorized local container, creates/removes a unique restricted database per release and stops the server afterwards. Coordinate with other authors before running.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API contract prepared using .NET11 GA SDK/runtime and EF11 RC2 packages; no experimental opt-in. Actual GA reconciliation remains outstanding.

sources.title: EF scalar and JSON path indexes

evidence.scope: Real SQL Server TPT/TPC value-converted JSON round-trips with comparer; scalar key/index, computed JSON index, explicit identity resolution and duplicate rejection.

Real SQL Server TPT scalar/JSON, TPC scalar and concrete-subtype JSON round-trips; nested scalar key/index, physical JSON index, LINQ identity resolution and duplicate rejection. Inherited-base TPC JSON and nested-key FindAsync are failing excluded RC2 paths.

humanProof.scope: Automated real SQL Server checks cover the declared bounded routes. Other providers/platforms and actual GA remain unverified; no Human gate is replaced.
